ov: حياة أو موت هو فيلم مصري عرض عام 1954، بطولة عماد حمدي ومديحة يسري، ومن إخراج كمال الشيخ.
plotEn: The film talks about the story of a man who is sick with the heart, so he sends his daughter to come to you with treatment and to cure the one who is in a hurry, but the person who gave his daughter the medicine discovers that this medicine contains a deadly poison because of the wrong composition of the medicine.
